ledger.note: 1585: Sumedang Larang declares itself sovereign. 'Under Geusan Ulun, the kingdom declared itself sovereign and separated from Cirebon' in 1585 ('about 35 years' of independence); Prince Angkawijaya had been crowned Prabu Geusan Ulun in 1578, inheriting Pajajaran, and Sunda fell in 1579 when Pulasari was taken by Maulana Yusuf of Banten. The infobox's 1529 is the page's other date.

notes: Cliopatria has no row for Sumedang Larang. Wikidata id not looked up (wikidata.org unreachable): null. Start 1585 is the body's date of sovereignty; the infobox dates independence to 1529 and the founding to 721 (Prabu Tajimalela, a descendant of Wretikandayun of Galuh), when the realm was a lord of Sunda and Galuh until the 16th century. The sunda-kingdom dossier lists this slug as a successor with Cliopatria's 1578 shape. In the grid Cirebon's 1579 shape holds all of Sunda's 1578 land, so 1578-1584 belongs to Cirebon and the 1585 event is a gain from it. The Mataram page's 'in 1631-36, Mataram had to suppress rebellion of Sumedang and Ukur' falls after the state's end and is not listed as a war. After 1620 Sumedang is a Mataram regency, which the page does not follow beyond 1636: a regency under the VOC after 1680-1681 is on the Mataram page. Gazetteer: Sumedang / Kutamaya, Priangan and Parahyangan are not in places/regions.
